display_long_description:
A massive cyber-invasion is breaking through into your reality. Crawlers and Malworms are swarming your own room, hunting for your memory cores. Fortify every corner, deploy your defenses, and react in real time as digital insects spill across your walls and floor. No two invasions are the same, your space becomes the battlefield.

This free demo gives you a taste of the full invasion with Level 1, playable in two ways:

Play with your hands or your controls.

Normal Mode — face a structured wave of Crawlers and Malworms and see if your defenses can hold
Endless Mode, how long can you survive as the swarm keeps coming?

Each mode can be played across two difficulty settings, so whether you're easing into mixed reality tower defense or looking for a real challenge, there's a fight suited to you.

Think fast, defend hard, and reclaim your reality. Do you dare?

Like what you see? Wishlist the full version of Xploit Tower Defense for more levels, more enemies, and the complete invasion.
